steps.name: Panicking Visitor
steps.text: Eek!

steps.name: Frightened Visitor
steps.text: Th-The mummy is moving!

steps.name: Frightened Visitor
steps.text: I'm getting out of here! This place is haunted!

steps.name: Frightened Visitor
steps.text: It's looking at me!

steps.name: Panicking Visitor
steps.text: I knew it!

steps.name: Panicking Visitor
steps.text: This is what happens when a city grows too old!

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Everyone! Stay calm! Don't panic!

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: The exit's over here! Stay in line, don't push!

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Make way, make way!

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Sorry, excuse me.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: *Sargon expletive* Anat! Anat!
Medjehtiqedti squeezes through the crowd to find a pale Anat lying limp on the ground, her lips parting weakly as though trying to speak.
But the sight of the mummy cocking its head behind Anat strikes her with such terror that she cannot move her feet.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Titi, go handle the evacuation. I'll try to take Anat and the mummy somewhere else.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Aren't you scared? It's moving!

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: I'm... alright. Ahem. I've been on two Old Calendar tomb excavations this year and met with their residents personally.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: This one looks like a nice old man by comparison.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: It really takes guts to do archaeology, huh? Are you going to be okay by yourself?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Don't worry, it takes plenty of strength to do archaeology too.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Titi...

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Anat?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: She's fine... just muttering in her sleep.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: The curator's office isn't far. Go out the side door and avoid the crowds. I'll come find you once the evacuation is complete.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: What's going on? I'm not in my ambush position yet! Did you turn on the smoke early?

steps.name: Left Earphone
steps.text: We didn't do anything.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: What's happening?

steps.name: Right Earphone
steps.text: Seems like someone else is causing a commotion.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Drat... I didn't see the target in the crowd. Where did she go?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Alright, change of plans. We're starting early. Find her, keep an eye on her, and keep me posted.

steps.name: Right Earphone
steps.text: Roger.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Hurry. We need to blend into the crowd once we're done.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: It'll be too late once the evacuation is finished.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Good... everyone is gone...
Pepe approaches the mummy and sees a blue light glowing in its chest.
The gem has vanished into the light and is nowhere to be seen.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Hrmph. So it was the gem...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: It's not easy to carry you like this...
After observing the mummy for a few seconds, Pepe decides to push the mummy's raised left arm back down.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: (Pushes the left arm down)

steps.name: Nameless Mummy
steps.text: (Raises right arm)

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: (Pushes the right arm down)

steps.name: Nameless Mummy
steps.text: (Raises left arm)

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: What's going on with you?
Pepe cocks her head and ponders how to get the mummy to cooperate.
To her surprise, she finds that the mummy also cocks its head, as if in thought.

spans.text: To her surprise, she finds that the mummy also cocks

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Wait... are you copying me?
Pepe takes a step to the left, and the mummy does the same.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Hm?
Pepe jumps backwards, and the mummy does the same, making a loud noise as it hits the wall behind it.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Pfft.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Looks like you can move your arms and legs, but not your brains.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Hey, if we can move in unison...
An idea comes to Pepe as she looks at Anat, who still lies passed out on the ground.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Almost to the curator's office. Alright, follow my movements and make a turn here.

steps.name: Nameless Mummy
steps.text: (Turns right)

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Gotta get it to hold Anat's shoulder tighter. She almost fell just now. Let's see...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: (Moves right hand)

steps.name: Nameless Mummy
steps.text: (Grabs Anat's shoulder)

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: (Frowns unconsciously)

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Alright. Now follow me...

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: (Moans unconsciously)

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Maybe we should take smaller steps...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: I'll consider that a yes.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Very good...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Wait, no, no, no—!
The mummy steps on the hem of its own robe and falls forward, right on top of Anat's tiny frame.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: (Groans unconsciously)

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: That red mark on her face isn't going away for a while...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Oh, you genius.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Come on, hold her tightly this time.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: (Frowns unconsciously)

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Walk with me. Not too fast, not too slow. Good... one-two... one-two...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Take it slow and easy. We're almost there.
Pepe turns her head to find her pass lying on the floor. It must have fallen out of her pocket.
She looks at her own raised arms, then at the mummy's holding Anat.
If the mummy let go, it would drop Anat on her head...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: How do I get into the office like this?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: I can't use my hands... I have to use my foot...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: (Reaches out one foot)

steps.name: Nameless Mummy
steps.text: (Reaches out one foot)

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Good, keep your balance.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Still can't reach it. I wish I didn't skip gym class...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Come on, you can do it!

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Argh—
Despite trying her best, the pass still lies just beyond Pepe's reach.
She stretches a little too far and loses her balance.
Following her lead, the mummy lets go of Anat and falls in the same way.
Pepe can only watch as Anat's skull hits the floor, making a dull sound on impact.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: (Unconscious cry)

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Sorry, Anat, I'll give you my full support on your next research project.

steps.name: Wandering Staff
steps.text: Hanimefendi, do you need help?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Oh, I'm so glad you're here. Your curator isn't feeling well. Can you help me carry her into the office?

steps.name: Wandering Staff
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Wandering Staff
steps.text: I set Curator Anat on the sofa. Your posture is... interesting. Are you sure you don't need help getting up?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: No, it's a special exercise I do.

steps.name: Wandering Staff
steps.text: Er, okay. What about the exhibit? Should I carry it inside too?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: No, I can handle it on my own.

steps.name: Wandering Staff
steps.text: Alright... let me know if you need anything else.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: I can finally move... that was close.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Stop staring and come in.

steps.name: Wandering Staff
steps.text: Good news, Narantuya, I found the target.

steps.name: Wandering Staff
steps.text: Yeah, near Hall Four. I helped her carry the unconscious curator into the office.

steps.name: Wandering Staff
steps.text: I'm certain she's in the office. There's no one else, other than the curator who's still out cold. I also have her pass.

steps.name: Wandering Staff
steps.text: No problem, I'll wait here for you.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Izaja?

steps.name: Wandering Staff
steps.text: Oh, Medjehtiqedti Hanimefendi, I...

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: What are you doing here, with the whole museum in chaos?

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: We're shutting things down for the day. Help lead these lost guests out.

steps.name: Lost Tourist
steps.text: What's going on? Where are we going?

steps.name: Lost Tourist
steps.text: Are we in danger?

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Don't worry, just follow our staff here and she'll take you to a safe place.

steps.name: Wandering Staff
steps.text: B-But I have other things to do...

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Alright, I will—

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Look out!

steps.name: Lost Tourist
steps.text: Wh-What happened?!

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Who brought a cloudbeast in here? Pets aren't allowed in the museum!

steps.name: Wandering Staff
steps.text: I-I didn't see any cloudbeasts...

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: We'll talk about your negligence later. I've got to catch it before someone steps on it.

steps.name: Wandering Staff
steps.text: ...I guess I'm guiding the tourists outside.

steps.name: Wandering Staff
steps.text: (Mutter) Well, I think I can still make it.

steps.name: Wandering Staff
steps.text: Follow me, everyone. The exit is this way, to the right.

steps.name: Lost Tourist
steps.text: Isn't that the left?

steps.name: Lost Tourist
steps.text: She's staff here, I'm sure she knows what she's doing... hey, wait for us!
A heavy exhibition hall door is pushed open, then closed again.
No one remembers that it should be open, no one cares that it was opened, and no one has cleaned the dusty sign that reads 'Northeastern Tributary Exhibit' in ages.
The hall is silent.
Aspasia's heart thumps against her chest, almost loud enough to drown out her whispering footsteps.
She passes by the black monuments of lost tribes and colorful Kjerag rugs, casting her gaze towards the dark depths of the hall.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: ...Finally.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Our history awaits me in silence.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: I must admit that one should look upon history with such solemnity.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: From which lost temple's relief was the scroll before me drawn? From which Minoan peak was such immaculately white marble hewn?

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: And such imagination, piecing together a corner of an ancient Minoan family with ancient artifacts.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: It's all wrong!

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: I recognize you, the golden goblet that once sat in the center of the temple. My grandfather came to visit you, many years ago, as did my mother after him.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Much has my family suffered for your loss.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Why has this museum put it among the clay bowls for fermented milk? They share no common material or style!

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: And where is the other half of the pair? The Sargonians took them all, yet they do not keep them safe!

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Even the exhibit description is—
She takes a long look at the exhibit label, then pulls the metal plate off the wall and looks to the other side.
Both sides are perfectly smooth, with only her own reflection upon them.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Signómi, this one was just left empty.

spans.text: , this one was just left empty.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: —But the biggest mistake is that these artifacts are here at all.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: A century ago, Minos suffered the shame of Sargonian armies violating her soil, trampling on our civilization and history.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: It should not have been so...

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: I must take them.

steps.name: Wandering Staff
steps.text: Follow this flight of stairs down, and you'll find the exit.

steps.name: Wandering Staff
steps.text: Now then, I have other business to attend to.

steps.name: Lost Tourist
steps.text: Something still doesn't feel right.

steps.name: Bewildered Tourist
steps.text: I don't think this is how we came in.

steps.name: Lost Tourist
steps.text: She's staff here. She knows what she's doing... right?

steps.name: Lost Tourist
steps.text: Will this way really take us home?

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: I must take you home.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: I must bring you to the priests of Minos, that they may study and preserve you.
Aspasia walks solemnly towards the exhibition pedestal and lifts the goblet.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Minoan artifacts must not be allowed to lie forgotten in this forsaken, sunless hall.

steps.name: Lost Tourist
steps.text: Don't push! I can't see where I'm going. Shouldn't they put an underground light or something in the emergency exit?

steps.name: Lost Tourist
steps.text: Hey, there's a lady there setting up the exhibit. She looks more reliable than the other one. Let's ask her!

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Have you come to see—

steps.name: Lost Tourist
steps.text: —Is this the way out of the museum?

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Is there something I can help you with?
